## Summary
Shahir Ahmed is a software engineer and M.S. Computer Science student at NYU (Sep 2026 to May 2028, expected). He was previously a software engineer at Sarva and a software engineer intern on FarmData2, and is ranked 25th of 600+ contributors to Mermaid.js. He works mostly in TypeScript, Java, and Python, with React, Next.js, Spring Boot, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

## Experience
### Software Engineer, Sarva (May 2025 - Sep 2026), Carlisle, PA
Sarva is a startup that helps neighborhood grocery shops manage inventory by voice: owners track stock, get low-stock alerts, and see what sold by speaking in 90+ languages. It also offers online ordering with pickup and delivery.
- Replaced pen and paper inventory at independent grocery stores with a voice assistant that updates stock in 90+ languages.
- Integrated Stripe so every payment splits between the store and the driver, and no card is charged until pickup.
- Improved product and inventory search by 7% by adding semantic search with OpenAI embeddings alongside keyword matching.
- Built 3 CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions running 2,604 unit tests across 173 REST API endpoints.
- Sarva was chosen for the gener8tor and Meta gBETA accelerator and named a finalist at the Ship Tank and launchU pitch competitions.

### Open Source Contributor, Mermaid.js (Jan 2025 - Apr 2026), Remote
- Ranked 25th of 600+ contributors by merging 3 pull requests into a diagramming library with 10M+ weekly downloads.
- Added data labels to bar charts, Knuth-Plass word wrapping for journey diagram legends, and journey diagram title styling in a 100,000 line TypeScript codebase used by GitHub and Microsoft.
- Wrote Cypress end-to-end tests for each feature.

### Software Engineer Intern, FarmData2 at Dickinson College (May 2024 - May 2025), Carlisle, PA
Paid internship on FarmData2, open source farm record-keeping software funded by the National Science Foundation.
- Cut page load time by 60% on a National Science Foundation funded farm platform by moving 22+ Vue.js components to Vuex.
- Automated crop logging with 18+ Node.js REST APIs and 30+ Cypress tests, saving farmers 12+ hours a week.

### Teaching Assistant, Dickinson College Computer Science Department (Sep 2022 - May 2025)
- Raised average assignment scores by 15% for 25+ students across 6 semesters through weekly Python and Java code reviews.

### Software Developer (Volunteer), 84 Lumber (Sep 2023 - Jan 2024), Remote
- Converted 10,000+ lines of legacy CBASIC into Python and Java for a $9B retailer by building a translator with ANTLR.

## Projects
### GrabPic
- URL: https://grab-pic.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Grab-Pic
- Event photo search. Upload a selfie to find your photos in albums of 500+ photos, matched in under 200 milliseconds. Built as 3 services (Next.js, Spring Boot, and a Python DeepFace/TensorFlow worker producing 512-dimension face embeddings), connected through Amazon SQS, with pgvector HNSW search, S3 presigned uploads, CloudFront signed URLs, Redis rate limiting, and Cloudflare Turnstile. Compute later moved to self-hosted containers behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, cutting hosting from about $85 to about $1 a month.

### PaperPulse
- URL: https://paper-pulse-nu.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Paper-Pulse
- Research assistant that answers questions from the full text of 100+ papers using retrieval augmented generation. Ranks papers from arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex every night and delivers the 25 most relevant to each user's feed. FastAPI, Next.js, Neo4j, pgvector, and Docker, deployed to AWS App Runner through GitHub Actions and Amazon ECR.

### Queue Up
- URL: https://queue-up.onrender.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Queue-Up
- Social app that matches people by Spotify listening history, with real-time WebSocket chat. Java, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL with Spring Data JPA, and Docker.

### Albatross (HackHarvard 2024)
- URL: https://albatross-hack.netlify.app/
- Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/albatross
- Built after two teammates had felt unsafe walking through parts of Boston. A navigation app that routes walkers around high crime areas, built by a team of 4 in 36 hours, with a working demo for Boston. Clustered 50K+ crime records into risk zones with MLflow and stored them in a Databricks Delta Lakehouse. Vue.js, Cloudflare Workers, and the Google Maps API.

### CoSign
- URL: https://cosign-nwwl.onrender.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/CoSign
- Task accountability app where users can't complete their own tasks. A verifier approves submitted proof through a task state machine, and if a deadline is missed the AES-encrypted hidden penalty is automatically emailed to the verifier. Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, WebSockets, Docker.

### BitTorrent Client JS
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/bittorrent-client-js
- BitTorrent client in Node.js for .torrent files and magnet links, with TCP peer connections, SHA-1 piece verification, and extension protocol metadata exchange.

### PandOS
- GitHub: https://gitfront.io/r/Shahir-47/abfsq8dhTm4Z/Custom-OS-Kernel/
- Operating system kernel in C for the uMPS3 emulator with time sharing, TLB-based virtual memory, system calls, and interrupt handling.

### SweetFriend (PennApps 2024)
- URL: https://sweet-friend.vercel.app/app/dashboard
- GitHub: https://github.com/dmicz/SweetFriend
- Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/sweetfriend
- Built with a teammate who lives with type 1 diabetes, to make carb counting and insulin dosing easier. Shahir built the React frontend and Chart.js glucose timeline. Diabetes management app with Dexcom glucose data, meal photo recognition, Twilio alerts, and a Flask and MongoDB backend.

### Prospectus (HoyaHacks 2024)
- Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/prospectus
- GitHub: https://github.com/HoyaHacks2024-Team
- Shahir's first hackathon. The team designed an AI college admissions assistant with React, Django, and Azure OpenAI, but did not finish a working product in time.
